account: Today I have kept my market walk, lunch and office appointments. Most residents offered little news, but several reported seeing the baker carrying a sack of bread at the inn and around the plaza. I also saw the baker stocking the bakery stall. Those activities could simply be ordinary deliveries, though the repeated reports have caught my attention. More unusually, freight asked the builder for a private discussion at the inn, and the builder spoke of a private word about their committee's supplies. I do not know what committee this is, what supplies they need, or whether the bread deliveries are connected. The builder also requested that I meet them for a great hall lighting inspection tomorrow precisely at 18:00. I accepted, and the secretary has now confirmed recording it in an appointment addendum. It may be routine municipal business, but the private supply discussion and precise evening appointment leave me curious about preparations I have not been told about. I have no evidence of wrongdoing or of a particular hidden purpose. The secretary reports no other urgent business and has confirmed today's 15:00 tea with the neighbour at the east-bank cottage, road point (16, -60, 105), door (16, -60, 104). During my accounts appointment I checked the treasury and found two stacks of 64 emeralds; without an earlier balance or ledger I cannot infer any discrepancy.
